full_prompt_en: A square architectural collage depicts a compact modular waterfront structure beneath a flat orange sun on a pale cream background. The structure rises from a long black horizontal base at the bottom, with a narrow band of muted water beneath it. On the left, stacked yellow rooms, balconies, and slim platforms step upward toward a tall rectangular chimney capped in black. Their faces carry tiny dark windows, railings, and one exposed red-brown stair. The middle holds white box-like volumes with gray openings and fine diagrammatic divisions. At the far right, the black base extends to a pointed end beyond the last small figures. Scattered human silhouettes stand on the lower platform and higher terraces, establishing scale without becoming the subject. A large ochre-orange disk occupies the upper right against the largely open cream sky. Thin poles, wires, antennas, and measured construction lines run vertically and horizontally through the open space, connecting the compact architecture to the otherwise empty field. A faint leafless tree appears behind the left side, its delicate branch texture much lighter than the built forms. Small marks and smudges float across the background like worn ink or weathered paper, but there is no clearly legible text. The image is almost orthographic and flat: large blocks are filled with mustard yellow, off-white, muted gray, and rusty red, while fine black outlines and occasional shadows define openings and overlaps. Light feels even and graphic rather than tied to a single physical source; the orange circle works as a bold color counterweight to the dark base. Fine grain and scuffed edges keep the clean geometry from feeling sterile. The overall composition is precise yet whimsical, balancing dense layered construction below with spacious pale negative space above.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形建筑拼贴描绘一组紧凑的模块化滨水建筑，浅奶油色背景上悬着扁平橙色太阳。建筑从底部一条长黑色水平基底向上升起，基底下是一窄条灰暗水面。左侧叠起的黄色房间、阳台和细平台逐级通向一根顶部涂黑的高矩形烟囱。立面带小深色窗洞、栏杆和一道外露的红棕楼梯。中央是白色箱状体块，带灰色开口与细密示意图般的分割。最右侧，黑色基底在最后几个人物之外延伸为尖端。下层平台和更高露台散布小小人物剪影，提供尺度却不成为主题。上右方一枚大赭橙圆盘占据大体开放的奶油色天空。细杆、电线、天线与量测般的建造线条纵横穿过空白处，把密集建筑与空旷区域连在一起。左侧后方可见淡淡的落叶树，细枝肌理比建筑体块浅得多。背景飘着小痕迹与污点，像磨旧油墨或风化纸面，但没有清楚可读的文字。画面几乎是正交视角和平面化的：大块面填入芥黄、灰白、灰色和锈红，细黑轮廓与偶尔的阴影界定开口和重叠。光感均匀而图形化，不依赖单一物理光源；橙圆成为深色底座的鲜明色彩对重。细颗粒和擦损边缘使干净几何不显无菌。整体构图精确却带奇想，以下方密集层叠建筑平衡上方宽裕浅色留白。
style_prompt_en: Architectural collage mixes flat geometric color blocks with fine diagrammatic drafting, weathered paper grain, and tiny dark scale marks. Mustard yellow, cream, gray, rusty red, and charcoal are distributed in sharply bounded planes; a concentrated orange circle can act as a strong counterweight to a dark horizontal anchor. Thin grids, poles, and hairline connectors give precise rhythm across open space without filling it completely. Rectangles step and overlap like a cut-paper construction, with modest shadow used mainly to clarify layers rather than create deep realism. Large pale negative space makes the compact lower cluster feel intricate and deliberate. Small irregular scratches, stains, and faded ink soften the engineered precision. The viewpoint is frontal and nearly orthographic, so proportion and color hierarchy matter more than dramatic perspective. The overall effect is analytical yet playful, combining a technical drawing's measured lines with a handmade collage's imperfect surface.
style_prompt_zh: 建筑拼贴把平坦几何色块与细密示意制图线、磨旧纸张颗粒及小小深色尺度点结合起来。芥黄、奶油白、灰、锈红和炭色分布在边界鲜明的色面中；集中的橙色圆形可与深色水平锚点形成有力对重。细网格、竖杆和发丝般连接线让开放空间有精确节奏，却不把它完全填满。矩形像剪纸建筑那样逐级叠压，适量阴影主要用于澄清层次而非制造深度写实。大片浅色留白使紧凑的下部群块显得复杂且有意安排。细小不规则划痕、污渍与褪色油墨柔化工程式精确感。视点正面且近乎正交，因此比例和色彩层级比戏剧性透视更重要。整体效果兼具分析感与趣味，把技术图纸的量测线条和手工拼贴的不完美表面结合起来。
theme_en: A modular yellow and white waterfront structure under a flat orange sun
theme_zh: 扁平橙色太阳下的黄白色模块化滨水建筑
name: Federico Babina
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
